title: Structure-Based and Glycosylation-Aware Interpretation of Glycogene Variants.
authors: Ohno, Shiho; Manabe, Noriyoshi; Kaname, Tadashi; Nishihara, Shoko; Yamaguchi, Yoshiki
one_liner_zh: 该综述探讨利用AlphaFold等结构预测工具和结构特征（如ΔΔG、pLDDT）解释糖基因错义变异，虽聚焦变异解读而非直接的结构计算建模，但涉及蛋白质结构预测和稳定性计算，对蛋白质结构计算课题有参考价值。
abstract: Missense variants in glycan-related genes (glycogenes) underlie many congenital disorders of glycosylation and related conditions, yet a large fraction remain classified as variants of uncertain significance. Because glycogenes often show low evolutionary conservation, conventional sequence-based predictors are frequently uninformative, making structure-based interpretation particularly valuable. This review examines how structure-based and glycosylation-aware approaches can improve the interpretation of glycogene variants. Advances in protein structure prediction, notably AlphaFold, now allow variant-induced structural perturbations to be assessed proteome-wide using structure-derived features such as solvent accessibility, thermodynamic stability (DeltaDeltaG), and local model confidence (pLDDT). Such structural features can be combined to predict the impact of glycogene variants, as exemplified by VarMeter and VarMeter2, which have successfully identified pathogenic missense variants of arylsulfatase L (ARSL) and N-sulfoglucosamine sulfohydrolase (SGSH) in patients with undiagnosed disease. Despite the progress in these tools, there remain challenges especially relevant to glycobiology, including the limited accuracy of current DeltaDeltaG predictors, the distinct behavior of gain-of-function and stabilizing variants, the need for proteome-scale computation, and the critical but still underexplored contribution of protein glycosylation to structural stability. We argue that incorporating glycosylation into structural energetics is a key next step toward more accurate, glyco-aware variant interpretation.
abstract_zh: 聚糖相关基因（glycogenes）中的错义变异是许多先天性糖基化障碍及相关疾病的病因，但其中很大一部分仍被归类为意义未明变异。由于糖基因通常表现出较低的系统发育保守性，传统的基于序列的预测工具往往信息有限，这使得基于结构的解读尤为宝贵。本综述探讨了基于结构和糖基化感知的方法如何改进糖基因变异的解读。蛋白质结构预测的进展，尤其是AlphaFold，现在使得能够利用结构衍生特征（如溶剂可及性、热力学稳定性（DeltaDeltaG）和局部模型置信度（pLDDT））在全蛋白质组范围内评估变异诱导的结构扰动。这些结构特征可以组合起来预测糖基因变异的影响，例如VarMeter和VarMeter2所展示的，它们成功识别了未诊断疾病患者中芳基硫酸酯酶L（ARSL）和N-磺基葡萄糖胺磺水解酶（SGSH）的致病性错义变异。尽管这些工具取得了进展，但仍存在与糖生物学特别相关的挑战，包括当前DeltaDeltaG预测器的有限准确性、功能获得性和稳定性变异的不同行为、对蛋白质组规模计算的需求，以及蛋白质糖基化对结构稳定性的关键但尚未充分探索的贡献。我们认为，将糖基化纳入结构能量学是迈向更准确、糖感知变异解读的关键下一步。
